sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Joystick Adventure revolves around guiding Joystick as he navigates through obstacles and challenges to reach his final goal. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with players required to tap on the screen to control Joystick's movements. The goal is to collect ores, take the key, and reach the door, all while avoiding obstacles and walls that can set you back.

As players progress through the levels, the obstacles become increasingly challenging, requiring players to use their reflexes and timing to avoid taking damage. If Joystick takes too much damage, the player will have to start over from the beginning, making it essential to stay focused and alert at all times. Despite the simplicity of the gameplay, Joystick Adventure requires a high level of skill and strategy to progress through the levels.

One of the unique features of Joystick Adventure is its use of a 'burn' system, where Joystick takes damage if he hits an obstacle. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, requiring players to carefully plan their movements and avoid taking unnecessary risks. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Joystick Adventure are engaging and addictive, making it a joy to play for players of all ages and skill levels.
